ei.title: The Public Mechanical Clock Promoted Western Economy
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: The Public Mechanical Clock Promoted Western Economy

fullPassage: Many historians have pointed to the significance of accurate time measurement to Western economic progress. The French historian Jacques Le Goff called the birth of the public mechanical clock a turning point in Western society. Until the late Middle Ages, people had sun or water clocks, which did not play any meaningful role in business activities. Market openings and activities started with the sunrise and typically ended at noon when the sun was at its peak. But when the first public mechanical clocks were introduced and spread across European cities, market times were set by the stroke of the hour. Public clocks thus greatly contributed to public life and work by providing a new concept of time that was easy for everyone to understand. This, in turn, helped facilitate trade and commerce. Interactions and transactions between consumers, retailers, and wholesalers became less irregular. Important town meetings began to follow the pace of the clock, allowing people to better plan their time and allocate resources in a more efficient manner.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

❌ ④ transactions — 원문 일치. 소비자/소매상 간의 '거래'라는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: spread across cities = 도시로 퍼졌다. retreated(후퇴)는 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 자원을 더 효율적으로 배분한다는 맥락. wasteful(낭비적인)은 efficient의 반의어
det.analysis:

✅ ④ wasteful — 원문은 efficient(효율적인). wasteful(낭비적인)로 바꾸면 '낭비적인 방식으로 자원 배분'이 되어 긍정적 기여 맥락에 모순 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 중요한 도시 회의가 시계의 속도(pace of the clock)를 따르기 시작했다
det.analysis:
❌ ① the rhythm of nature: 자연의 리듬은 기계시계 이전의 기준이지 도입 후가 아님
❌ ② the schedule of merchants: 상인의 일정이 아닌 시계의 속도를 따랐다는 맥락
✅ ③ the pace of the clock: 원문 일치. 'Important town meetings began to follow the pace of the clock' ←정답
❌ ④ the demand of consumers: 소비자 수요가 아닌 시계를 기준으로 회의 진행
det.tip: follow the pace of the clock = 시계의 속도를 따르다

det.korean: 거래가 덜 불규칙(less irregular)해졌다는 것은 시계 도입으로 규칙성이 생겼다는 의미

det.tip: became less irregular = 덜 불규칙해졌다 = 더 규칙적이 됨

questions.passage: Many historians have pointed to the significance of accurate time measurement to Western economic progress. The French historian Jacques Le Goff called the birth of the public mechanical clock a turning point in Western society. Until the late Middle Ages, people had sun or water clocks, which did not play any meaningful role in business activities. Market openings and activities started with the sunrise and typically ended at noon when the sun was at its peak. But when the first public mechanical clocks were introduced and spread across European cities, market times were set by the stroke of the hour. Public clocks thus greatly contributed to public life and work by providing a new concept of time that was easy for everyone to understand. This, in turn, helped facilitate trade and commerce. Interactions and transactions between consumers, retailers, and wholesalers became less irregular. Important town meetings began to follow the pace of the clock, allowing people to better plan their time and allocate resources in a more efficient manner.
